'''2007 Illinois State Championship Andrew Shuman DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Shuman]] at [[2007 Illinois State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' www.billywitchdoctor.com
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
